title: dedicated: priority-aware burst smoothing + utilization reporting enhancements
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: Reduce customer-facing latency spikes during short high-QPS bursts while preserving throughput guarantees for higher-priority tenants; also improve fleet-level utilization reporting so SRE and capacity planning teams can tune reserved capacity more precisely. What: 1) Implement priority-aware token-bucket smoothing in the dedicated autoscaler to allow burst capacity to be distributed by configured priority_weights. 2) Add a new burst_capacity config and burst_smoothing.window_ms to the autoscaler policy. 3) Emit new telemetry: dedicated.autoscaler.burst_allocations, dedicated.autoscaler.priority_utilization, dedicated.autoscaler.queue_latency_p99 and augment existing fleet.utilization time series with priority labels. 4) Dashboard: add a Dedicated Fleet -> Autoscaler -> Burst Utilization dashboard and example alerts for burst_depletion and priority-starvation. 5) Tests: unit and e2e coverage for smoothing and reporting. Backwards compatibility: new fields are optional and default to previous behavior. Migration: operators can tune burst_capacity and priority_weights via values.yaml; documented in docs/dedicated/autoscaler.md. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests - [x] e2e tests - [x] docs - [x] dashboards - [x] changelog/release notes
